text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious,
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: By the dispatched (angels), in succession.
text_1989: (Angels) dispatched in succession.
text_ref: (Angels) dispatched in succession.

text_1981: Who stir up violent winds.
text_1989: To drive the wind.
text_ref: To drive the wind.

text_1981: And spread clouds everywhere.
text_1989: Stir up clouds.
text_ref: Stir up clouds.

text_1981: And distribute the rain.
text_1989: Distribute the provisions.
text_ref: Distribute the provisions.

text_1981: And deliver messages.
text_1989: Deliver messages.
text_ref: Deliver messages.

text_1981: Good news as well as warnings.
text_1989: Good news, as well as warnings.
text_ref: Good news, as well as warnings.

text_1981: What is promised to you will come to pass.
text_1989: What is promised will come to pass.
text_ref: What is promised will come to pass.

text_1981: The stars will be turned off.
text_1989: Thus, when the stars are put out.
text_ref: Thus, when the stars are put out.

text_1981: The heaven will be tom.
text_1989: The sky is opened up.
text_ref: The sky is opened up.

text_1981: The mountains will be wiped out.
text_1989: The mountains are blown up.
text_ref: The mountains are blown up.

text_1981: The messengers will be summoned.
text_1989: The messengers are summoned.
text_ref: The messengers are summoned.

text_1981: On the specific day.
text_1989: That is the appointed day.
text_ref: That is the appointed day.

text_1981: That is the day of judgment.
text_1989: The Day of Decision.
text_ref: The Day of Decision.

text_1981: Do you have any idea what the day of judgment is?
text_1989: What a Day of Decision!
text_ref: What a Day of Decision!

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: Did we not eliminate the ancestors?
text_1989: Did we not annihilate the earlier generations?
text_ref: Did we not annihilate the earlier generations?

text_1981: Then we made others follow them?
text_1989: Then we made others follow them?
text_ref: Then we made others follow them?

text_1981: This is what we do to the guilty.
text_1989: This is what we do to the criminals.
text_ref: This is what we do to the criminals.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors. 2 2677
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?
text_1989: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?*
text_ref: Did we not create you from a lowly liquid?*
footnote_ref: *77:20-23 According to Langman's Medical Embryology, by T. W. Sadler (Fifth Edition, Page 88): "In general the length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days or 38 weeks after fertilization." Both 266 and 38 are multiples of 19 (Appendix 1).

text_1981: Then we placed it in a protected repository.
text_1989: Then we placed it in a well-protected repository.
text_ref: Then we placed it in a well-protected repository.

text_1981: For a specific period.
text_1989: For a specific period.
text_ref: For a specific period.

text_1981: We designed everything; we are the best designers.
text_1989: We measured it precisely.* We are the best designers.
text_ref: We measured it precisely.* We are the best designers.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: Did we not make the earth habitable?
text_1989: Did we not make the earth an abode?
text_ref: Did we not make the earth an abode?

text_1981: Accommodating both the living and the dead.
text_1989: For the living and the dead?
text_ref: For the living and the dead?

text_1981: We placed huge stabilizers therein, and we gave you fresh water to drink.
text_1989: We placed on it high mountains, and provided you with fresh water to drink.
text_ref: We placed on it high mountains, and provided you with fresh water to drink.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: Go to what you used to deny.
text_1989: Go to what you used to disbelieve in.
text_ref: Go to what you used to disbelieve in.

text_1981: Go to a shade with three layers.
text_1989: Go to a shade of three different densities.
text_ref: Go to a shade of three different densities.

text_1981: It provides no coolness, nor does it spare you any heat.
text_1989: Yet, it provides neither coolness, nor protection from the heat.
text_ref: Yet, it provides neither coolness, nor protection from the heat.

text_1981: The sparks it emits are as big as mansions.
text_1989: It throws sparks as big as mansions.
text_ref: It throws sparks as big as mansions.

text_1981: They will look as yellow as the camels.
text_1989: As yellow as the color of camels.
text_ref: As yellow as the color of camels.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers. 35.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: That is the day they do not speak.
text_1989: That is the day they do not speak.
text_ref: That is the day they do not speak.

text_1981: No permission will be given to them to even apologize.
text_1989: Nor are they given permission to apologize.
text_ref: Nor are they given permission to apologize.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers. 38.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: This is the Day of Decision. We have summoned you and the previous generations.
text_1989: This is the Day of Decision. We have summoned you and the previous generations.
text_ref: This is the Day of Decision. We have summoned you and the previous generations.

text_1981: If you have any power to do anything, then show Me your power.
text_1989: If you have any schemes, go ahead and scheme.
text_ref: If you have any schemes, go ahead and scheme.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: The righteous have deserved shade and springs.
text_1989: The righteous will enjoy shade and springs.
text_ref: The righteous will enjoy shade and springs.

text_1981: And all the fruits they desire.
text_1989: And fruits that they desire.
text_ref: And fruits that they desire.

text_1981: Eat and drink happily, in return for your works.
text_1989: Eat and drink happily in return for your works.
text_ref: Eat and drink happily in return for your works.

text_1981: We thus reward the righteous.
text_1989: We thus reward the virtuous.
text_ref: We thus reward the virtuous.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: Eat and enjoy for a short while; you are guilty.
text_1989: Eat and enjoy temporarily; you are guilty.
text_ref: Eat and enjoy temporarily; you are guilty.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors. 581
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: When told, “Bow down (in salat),” they do not bow down.
text_1989: When they are told, “Bow down,” they do not bow down.
text_ref: When they are told, "Bow down," they do not bow down.

text_1981: Woe, on that day, to the disbelievers.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_ref: Woe on that day to the rejectors.

text_1981: Which hadith, besides this, do they believe in?
text_1989: Which Hadith, other than this, do they uphold?
text_ref: Which Hadith, other than this, do they uphold?
